entries.text: I feel pretty good but my left foot is making my mobility an issue today . Having some difficulty walking but making the best of it . I can complain but there is nothing anyone can do to help me .\ n \ nI also would like to know how is it possible to write a minimum of 200 words in two to three sentences . Please correct this before this becomes a bigger problem for everyone in this study .
